## Physical scenario

A machine part as shown in figure consists of three small disks linked by lightweight struts.

## Question

What is the body's kinetic energy if it rotates about axis 1 with angular speed \( \omega = 4.0 \text{ rad/s} \)?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( 0.66 \text{ J} \)

- B: B: \( 0.46 \text{ J} \)

- C: C: \( 1.32 \text{ J} \)

- D: D: \( 0.92  \text{ J} \)

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image is a diagram showing three disks labeled A, B, and C. 

- **Disk A** is marked with an "Axis 1" perpendicular to the plane of the figure, has a mass \( m_A = 0.30 \, \text{kg} \), and is connected to Disk B by a bar measuring \( 0.50 \, \text{m} \).
  
- **Disk B** has a mass \( m_B = 0.10 \, \text{kg} \) and is connected directly below Disk C by a vertical bar measuring \( 0.30 \, \text{m} \). An "Axis 2" runs through disks B and C.
  
- **Disk C** has a mass \( m_C = 0.20 \, \text{kg} \) and is connected to Disk A by a bar measuring \( 0.40 \, \text{m} \).

The lines connecting disks represent rigid bars or rods, forming a triangular configuration. The masses and distances are annotated next to the relevant sections of the diagram.

Rotational Motion; Physical Model Grounding Reasoning, Spatial Relation Reasoning
